rows.text: zeroes the first 0x17 bytes of `rcx`: qwords `+0` and `+8`, dword `+0x10`, word `+0x14` and byte `+0x16`
returns the call at `00264110` + 0x2A with its arguments shifted one place right and 1 inserted first: (1, `ecx`, `edx`, `r8`, `r9`, the fifth (stack) argument, the sixth (stack) argument)

zeroes the dwords at `r9` and at the fifth, sixth and seventh (stack) argument pointers, then takes the record at qword `02098E10` + `edx` times 0x288 and returns 0 when it is null; resolves `r8d` as an index (-1 to signed word `+0x52`, then -2 to word `+0x78`, then -3 to word `+0x7A`, tested in that order, then a negative value to word `+0x52`, and a value still negative to 0); returns 0 when word `+0` is at most 2, when the call at `00264B90` + 0xA8 with dword `+0x54` (`ecx` 0) or dword `+0x84` (`ecx` non-zero) returns 0, or when the index is not below (unsigned) the dword at the record plus the low 32 bits of that result; otherwise copies the dwords at that base plus 0x20 times the index plus 4, 8, 0xC and 0x10 to the four out pointers and returns 1

takes qword `+0xD8` of qword `0209AC30`, or qword `+0x100` when that is null, and returns without work when both are null; otherwise stores 1 at dword `+0xCC` and the qword 2 at `+0xC4` of that object, then, when `ecx` is -1, sets its dword `+0xC0` to 0xA if it is 0, and for any other `ecx` sets it to 1 if it is 9
returns `022D7FD0` + `ecx` times 0xA8 when `ecx` is at most 0xE (unsigned), otherwise 0
returns 1 when byte `01EFAC12` is not 2 or when bit 1 (`0x2`) of byte `+0xC4` of qword `02AEE4C8` is set, otherwise 0
returns 1 when bit `ecx` (modulo 32) of the sign-extended byte `02B59350` is set, otherwise 0

indexes the qword table `02CA96E0` by the signed dword at offset `0x7370` plus 4 times signed dword `+0xF0` of qword `+0x160` of qword `0209AC30`, inside the block at qword `02EBF190`; when the entry is null, makes the call at `005688D0` + 0x58 and returns 1; otherwise makes the call at `005688D0` + 0x3A (`rcx` still that index) and returns 0 when bit 1 (`0x2`) of the entry's byte `+0x358` is clear or the call returned 2 or 3, else makes the call at `005688D0` + 0x58 and returns 1

notes: 002D75F0: the je at 002D7621 cannot be taken (the +0x100 qword was already found non-null), so the stores at +0xCC and +0xC4 always run on the chosen object. 003944D0: the listing's static byte value (0x06) at 01EFAC12 is not used in the row. 005688D0: the call at +0x3A receives rcx = the table index left by the movsxd at 005688F9; whether the callee reads it is not visible here.
